text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Japanese Derby fast approaching, Agnes Tachyon is unusually diligent in her training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During all this, Manhattan Cafe points out that Agnes Tachyon's running is different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I approach her about this apparent change, but she evades my inquiry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With my uncertainties and doubts left unanswered, we make our moves for the big stage this coming summer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to change her schedule from running in the Japanese Derby to the NHK Mile C. due to her increasing lack of motivation.
